$comment: THE single greppable place the Windows installer's size budget lives.
CI (build/measure_footprint.py --budget) fails the build when a measured
value exceeds its budget. A budget nobody enforces is a wish, so the
enforcement is a test (installer/tests/test_installer_contract.py) plus a
workflow step that is not allowed to continue-on-error.
Units: mebibytes (1 MiB = 1048576 bytes), matching the `currency_units` key.
Provenance for every number is in docs/INSTALLER.md; each `measured_on` field
records the machine the number came from.

budgets.$comment_installer_script: The bootstrapping script itself. It is plain text downloaded by the user, so it must stay small enough to fetch and read.
budgets.$comment_installed_footprint: Everything the native (no-Docker) path puts on the machine: uv, CPython, the production venv, Node, the prebuilt frontend and the source checkout.
budgets.$comment_source_checkout: A shallow clone of the pinned tag, excluding .venv/node_modules/.next which are accounted for separately.

measured.$comment: Recorded on 2026-09-26, Windows 11 build 22631, AMD64, PowerShell 5.1.22621.2506. Values are MEASURED unless the key says estimate.
measured.uv_shared_cache_note: This machine's shared cache across every uv project. NOT representative of a single fresh install; a fresh install's cache is bounded by the wheels that venv actually needs.
